verifications.claim: As of early March 22, 2026, Sony reports that most PlayStation Network services are restored following a widespread outage on Saturday evening.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Sony's status page has since been updated to indicate that all services are back online'; R5: March 22, 2026 updates at 1:16 AM 'recovery is nearly complete'; R2: 'Sony reports services restored, but some users continue to experience issues'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Sony's status page reports services restored around early March 22 after March 21 outage; 'most' aligns with official all-up status plus noted residual user issues.

verifications.claim: The outage affected PS4 and PS5 users worldwide.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'impacted PS4 and PS5'; R2: 'online play on both PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4... across multiple continents'; R3: 'affected the Gaming & Social services worldwide... PS5, PS4'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state impact on PS4/PS5 users globally or across continents.

verifications.claim: PlayStation Network services are listed as operational.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'All services are up and running'; R2: 'status page has since been updated to indicate that all services are back online'; R3: 'All services online'; R5: 'Status page now says all services are online'
verifications.reasoning: Official status page and articles directly confirm services listed as operational/up.

verifications.claim: The status of PlayStation Network services is Mostly resolved/Stable.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R4: 'All services are up and running'; R2: 'all services are back online... but the picture remains uneven'; R5: 'recovery is nearly complete... a few people will still have hiccups'
verifications.reasoning: Official status is fully up/stable, but sources note lingering user issues, supporting 'mostly resolved' broadly but not precisely.
